contract_basis: BATCH-03 contract-lock-v1: server, not model, owns evidence status.
PRODUCT-FREEZE.md P0-1: scope comparison order is order_id -> sku_id -> fulfillment_item_id -> issue_type.
docs/03-firewall-rules.md: unknown or conflicting evidence routes to NEED_HUMAN_REVIEW; scope changes explain E2.
PRODUCT-FREEZE.md A26: image text asserting evidence validity is not a rule fact.

usable_source: product_role equals the current item role
component_coverage: the current affected component is known
observed affected_component equals the current affected component

decision_precedence.when: one or more scope fields differ
decision_precedence.reason: Report every changed scope level in the frozen comparison order.

decision_precedence.when: reliable sources conflict, a source is internally inconsistent, an integrity concern exists, or an evidence identifier is duplicated
decision_precedence.reason: Do not infer a fact from conflicting observations.

decision_precedence.when: a reliable source explicitly mismatches SKU, item role, or affected component
decision_precedence.reason: The evidence concerns another product or component.

decision_precedence.when: no observations, an unknown current component, or any required coverage fact is absent
decision_precedence.reason: The server lacks enough deterministic facts.

decision_precedence.when: scope matches and compatible reliable sources jointly satisfy all required coverage
decision_precedence.reason: No declaration or confidence value can replace these facts.

adverse_reaction_boundary: The aggregator does not diagnose or classify an adverse reaction. issue_type remains a scope fact; the later H1 rule independently routes ADVERSE_REACTION to HUMAN_REVIEW even when this aggregation is VALID.
